stories.title: 10-Year Treasury Yield Steadies After a Volatile Week
stories.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield ended the week little changed, according to CNBC, after a stretch of sharp moves. Earlier in the week the yield touched a 19-year high, a level some investors said made bonds worth buying again.
stories.whyItMatters: Treasury yields set the benchmark for mortgage rates, corporate borrowing costs, and equity valuations, so a volatile week here ripples across markets.
whatToWatch: Whether the 10-year yield holds near its 19-year high into next week
questions: Are buyers stepping in at these yield levels, or is the selloff just pausing?
